consequence.statement: Hubble CLI `--cluster foo` now also shows flows from nodes outside cluster foo that go to or come from it; use `--node-name foo/` for the previous behavior.
consequence.remediation: Replace `--cluster foo` with `--node-name foo/` where the old behavior is needed.

assertion.statement: The Hubble CLI `--cluster` flag now shows flows from nodes outside the named cluster (to or from the target cluster); the old behavior can be reproduced with `--node-name foo/`.

proposal.undeterminedReason: applicability: Hubble CLI invocation is a user-run command, not visible in Helm values or manifests; no predicate can express its usage.
